title: Explorer entity registry
responsibility: Builds categorized active entities and selected-commit removal entries from revision data.

inputs.name: explorerChange.head
inputs.description: The revision whose optional source-impact mark lists are searched for the unit ID. No matching mark, including when source impact is absent, produces null.

inputs.name: explorerChange.unit
inputs.description: The unit ID checked against the revision's added, direct, indirect, then removed lists. The first matching mark wins; an absent source-impact record or no match produces null.

inputs.name: explorerEntity.head
inputs.description: When the unit qualifies for a category, this revision supplies the verdict and change mark. It does not determine the unit's category.

inputs.name: explorerEntity.unit
inputs.description: The candidate unit passed to the category, role, name, verdict, and route helpers; its ID and responsibility are copied to the result. The result is null if no category applies and private-function inclusion is not enabled.

examples.title: Explorer entity registry
examples.responsibility: Builds categorized active entities and selected-commit removal entries from revision data.

inputs.name: explorerEntity.includePrivate
inputs.description: When true, an otherwise uncategorized unit whose kind resolves to functions can be returned as a functions entity. This flag applies to the single-entity lookup; collections do not enable it.

inputs.name: explorerEntities.head
inputs.description: The revision whose registry supplies active units and whose removed mark list identifies possible removals. Active units without a category are omitted.

inputs.name: explorerEntities.parent
inputs.description: The optional first-parent revision used to recover the last active form of units removed by head. If omitted or null, no removal entries are added.

outputs.name: explorerChange
outputs.description: The first matching mark in added, direct, indirect, removed order. It is null when source impact is absent or none of those lists contains the unit ID.

outputs.name: explorerEntity
outputs.description: A categorized unit projected to id, category, role, name, purpose, unit, verdict, change, and appRoute. It is null when no category applies, including an unrequested private function.

outputs.name: explorerEntities
outputs.description: Active head units and eligible removals, grouped in explorer-category order while preserving registry order within those groups. A removal must be named by head's removed marks, be active in parent, and no longer be active in head; it uses the parent's unit data, change removed, lastAt parent.commit, and an unpassed Removed at this commit verdict.
